thoronir_church_1.m: This is our chapel of worship in Fallhaven. Our community turns to us for support.

thoronir_church_2.m: This church has withstood hundreds of years, and has been kept safe from grave robbers.

thoronir_church_3.m: The catacombs beneath the church house the remains of our passed leaders. Our great King Luthor is rumored to be buried there.
r: There was something else I wanted to talk about.

thoronir_church_4.m: No one is allowed down in the catacombs, except for Athamyr, my apprentice. He is the only one that has been down there for years.
r: OK, I might go see him.

thoronir_complete_2.m: Give me some time to mix the bonemeal potion. It is a very potent healing potion. Come back in a little while.

thoronir_complete_2a.m: Give me some time to ... prepare. Come back in a little while.

r: Ehm ... My father has cut himself with an axe, and we don't have any bandages!
Fanamor, a member of Thieves' Guild, is severely wounded. Please give me a bandage for her!

thoronir_guild_3.m: This is what I have, take it. I expect this will be useful.
r: May the Shadow walk with you, my friend.
Thank you, I won't forget this!

thoronir_shadow_1.m: The Shadow protects us from the dangers of the night. It keeps us safe and comforts us when we sleep.
r: Tharal sent me and told me to tell you the password 'Glow of the Shadow'.

thoronir_shadow_score_average.m: Bask in the Shadow, my child.

thoronir_shadow_score_high.m: I am happy to see you. May the Shadow always be with you.

thoronir_shadow_score_low1.m: I have the strong feeling that you are not following the Shadow.

thoronir_shadow_score_low3.m: I know you are illoyal to the Shadow. It would be better if you leave now.

thoronir_shadow_score_max.m: Welcome my truest follower of the Shadow.

thoronir_shadow_score_very_high.m: I am very happy to see you. May the Shadow always be with you.

thoronir_start.m: What can I do for you?
r: What can you tell me about the Shadow?
Can you tell me more about the church?
Are the Bonemeal potions ready yet?
Do you have some special white powdered potions whose name must not be mentioned?
I need some help finding out who is responsible for casting a Shadow spell that causes a person to become noticeable.

thoronir_tharal_1.m: Glow of the Shadow indeed my child. So my old friend Tharal in Crossglen village sent you?
r: What can you tell me about bonemeal?

thoronir_tharal_2.m: Shhh, we shouldn't talk so loud about using bonemeal. As you know, Lord Geomyr issued a ban on all use of bonemeal.

thoronir_tharal_3.m: When the ban came, I did not dare keep any, so I threw my whole supply away. It was quite foolish now that I look back on it.

thoronir_tharal_4.m: Do you think you could find me 5 skeletal bones that I can use for mixing a bonemeal potion? The bonemeal is very potent in healing old wounds.
r: Sure, I might be able to do that.
I have those bones for you.
I've changed my mind. If Lord Geomyr forbids bonemeal potions, we should abide by that.

thoronir_tharal_4a.m: Well, do you think you could find me 5 skeletal bones that I can use for ... church matters?
r: Sure, I might be able to do that.
I have those bones for you.

thoronir_tharal_4b.m: That's very sincere of you. Perhaps you could still get me the bones. I need them also for church business, and I've recently run out of them.
r: Sure, I might be able to do that.
I have those bones for you.

thoronir_tharal_5.m: Thank you, please come back soon. I heard there were some undead near an old abandoned house just north of Fallhaven. Maybe you can check for bones there?

thoronir_tharal_5a.m: Thank you, please come back soon. I heard there were some undead near an old abandoned house just north of Fallhaven. Maybe you can check for bones there?

thoronir_tharal_complete.m: Thank you, these bones will do fine. Now I can start creating some bonemeal healing potions for you.

thoronir_tharal_complete_a.m: Thank you, these bones will do fine. Now I can start creating some ... things.

thoronir_trade_bonemeal.m: Yes, the bonemeal potions are ready. Please use them with care, and don't let the guards see you. We are not actually allowed to use them anymore.
r: Let me see what potions you have made so far.
There was something else I wanted to talk about.

thoronir_trade_bonemeal_a.m: Yes, the bo ... I mean, yes, I have some of these potions ready. For the small sum of 200 gold pieces, I can show them to you. Perhaps you'd like to buy some of them then. Just don't let anybody see them.
r: Here are 200 gold. Now let me see the potions.
There was something else I wanted to talk about.

tt_thoronir_10.m: You must be confusing me with someone else.

troubling_times.10: I went to the Thieves' Guild in Fallhaven looking for things to do.
troubling_times.20: Since I had helped Defy, Umar and Nanath threw me out. I cannot enter the basement again.
troubling_times.30: Since I had looted the Thieves' Guild vault after killing Defy, Umar and Nanath threw me out. I cannot enter the basement again.
troubling_times.40: I met Nanath, who's scared and upset, because someone put a spell on all members of the Thieves' Guild. This spell made all thieves noticeable. He asked me if I could help dispel the spell.
troubling_times.50: Nanath told me to find the Shadow priest who had cast the spell on the Guild.
troubling_times.60: I set out interviewing Shadow priests to find who had cast the spell.
troubling_times.70: Talion, Shadow priest of Loneford, had cast the Striking Spectacle Shadow spell on the Guild, on payment from Dameni, a mysterious lady leading a band of toughs
troubling_times.80: Talion could dispel the spell, using a few items - Villain's ring, Troublemaker's ring, ring of backstabbing, Tears of the Shadow potion, Luthor's ring.  He also wanted 50000 gold.
troubling_times.82: I have informed Nanath about the Striking Spectacle Shadow spell and Talion's demands.
troubling_times.90: Nanath told me Thieves' Guild would give me the 50000 gold back when I have got the spell dispelled.
troubling_times.95: Nanath asked if I had already found Luthor's ring.
troubling_times.100: I went back to Nanath as I couldn't find Luthor's ring anywhere.
troubling_times.105: He told me to seek out Fanamor's friend Sly Seraphina near the Sutdover bridge.
troubling_times.110: Seraphina didn't believe me. She told me to go away.
troubling_times.115: Nanath sent me to Umar. He should make sure Sly carries out the order.
troubling_times.120: Umar told me one of his secret passwords to convince Seraphina.
troubling_times.130: Sly Seraphina said that Luthor's ring was to be found in the cave which Crackshot tried to open. The door was sealed by Umar and Seraphina to prevent monsters in that cave from devastating Dhayavar. The sealing was done by using Luthor's items. She and Umar decided to separate them, and keep them separate.
troubling_times.140: Seraphina felt that the danger was too high to open that door. So she disappeared.
troubling_times.150: I had to find Sly Seraphina again.
troubling_times.160: Nanath told me to look for her in her usual hiding places: Near one of the towns Sullengard, Stoutford, Vilegard, Prim, Loneford, or Brimhaven.
troubling_times.170: Talion said that without the items he asked for he couldn't help. I had to find Seraphina.
troubling_times.180: After beating the tough guys protecting Seraphina, she was convinced that I was strong enough to help her beat the monsters in the cave.
troubling_times.190: Seraphina gave me back the money she had stolen from me earlier.
troubling_times.192: I have to ask Umar for Luthor's key.
troubling_times.195: Seraphina agreed to help me and told me to meet her at the locked door in the cave where Crackshot was defeated.
troubling_times.200: I met Seraphina at the cave door where Crackshot was defeated.
troubling_times.210: Seraphina could open the door with Luthor's key wearing also his gloves. She entered the cave behind the door.
troubling_times.230: Seraphina got injured attacking one of the monsters.
troubling_times.240: I have killed the monsters blocking the entrance.
troubling_times.252: I tried to poison Seraphina, but she noticed in time. At least she didn't notice that I did it on purpose.
troubling_times.255: Seraphina already started the search for the ring.
troubling_times.260: I searched the cave for Luthor's ring. I couldn't find it.
troubling_times.270: Sly Seraphina had found the ring. She gave it to me and told me to keep it safe. She disappeared again, probably back to Sutdover bridge. I had to go to Talion.
troubling_times.280: I gave 50000 gold, Villain's ring, Troublemaker's ring, ring of backstabbing, Tears of the Shadow potion, and Luthor's ring to Talion.
troubling_times.290: Talion used them to undo the spell.
troubling_times.300: Talion returned Luthor's ring. The other rings were broken in the process though and the Tears of the Shadow potion was used up of course.
troubling_times.302: The room with the dangerous creatures has been locked and sealed again.
troubling_times.310: Nanath gave me 75000 gold as a reward for a job well done.
troubling_times.320: Sly Seraphina was friendly to me - for now.

bonemeal.10:
Leonid in Crossglen town hall tells me that there was a disturbance in the village some weeks ago. Apparently, Lord Geomyr has banned all use of bonemeal as a healing substance.

Tharal, the town priest should know more.
bonemeal.20: Tharal does not want to talk about bonemeal. I might be able to persuade him by bringing him 5 insect wings.
bonemeal.30: Tharal tells me that bonemeal is a very potent healing substance, and is quite upset that it is not allowed anymore. I should go see Thoronir in Fallhaven if I want to learn more. I should tell him the password 'Glow of the Shadow'.
bonemeal.40: I have talked to Thoronir in Fallhaven. He might be able to mix me a bonemeal potion if I bring him 5 skeletal bones. There should be some skeletons in an abandoned house north of Fallhaven.
bonemeal.50: Thoronir in Fallhaven explained to me that bonemeal potions are banned by Lord Geomyr, so I have refused his request to provide him with fresh ingredients for new bonemeal potions. I could do him a favour though to bring him 5 skeletal bones for church matters. There should be some skeletons in an abandoned house north of Fallhaven.
bonemeal.100:
I have brought the bones to Thoronir. He is now able to supply me with bonemeal potions.
I should be careful when using them though, since Lord Geomyr has banned their use.
bonemeal.110: I have brought the bones to Thoronir. Of course he wouldn't produce any bonemeal potion from them though, since Lord Geomyr has banned their use.

Thieves01.5:
After giving him the key of Luthor and talking with Umar about Andor, I needed to ask him about Thieves' Guild itself.
I want to join them to see what kind of jobs they do.
Thieves01.10: Umar told me to talk with Troublemaker regarding my first task for the Guild.
Thieves01.15: Troublemaker told me to bring him three journals from spies of the guild. First I have to talk with Leta in my village, then with Dunla in Vilegard's tavern, and finally with Fanamor somewhere around Crossroads guardhouse.
Thieves01.20: I have to remember to tell them the password "You are no one. No one knows you. No one has seen you."
Thieves01.25: Leta gave me her journal and advised me to not raise suspicion.
Thieves01.30: I got Dunla's journal without any problem. I have set out to get the last journal.
Thieves01.40: Fanamor has been gravely wounded, and the Feygard Scout grabbed the journal.
Thieves01.45: After I had killed the Feygard scout I talked again with Fanamor. She's losing blood quickly, so I have to bring her a bandage. I need to find a trustworthy priest.
Thieves01.50: Thoronir gave me a bandage. I have to return to Fanamor as soon as possible.
Thieves01.51: Unfortunately, I was not able to save Fanamor's life. However, I did get her journal.
Thieves01.55: Fanamor is alive and will find her own way to return.
Thieves01.60: I returned to Troublemaker and gave him the journals. He told me to talk with Umar, maybe he has another task for me.

bucus.10: Bucus in Fallhaven might know something about Andor. He wants me to bring him the key of Luthor from the catacombs beneath Fallhaven church.
bucus.20: The catacombs beneath Fallhaven church are closed off. Athamyr is the only one with both permission and the bravery to enter them. I should go see him in his house southwest of the church.
bucus.30: Athamyr wants me to bring him some cooked meat, then maybe he will want to talk more.
bucus.40: I brought some cooked meat to Athamyr.
bucus.50: Athamyr has given me permission to enter the catacombs beneath Fallhaven church.
bucus.100: I brought Bucus the key of Luthor.
